title: Trichodimerol inhibits inflammation through suppression of the nuclear transcription factor-kappaB/NOD-like receptor thermal protein domain associated protein 3 signaling pathway.
authors: Huo, Xue-Yan; Lei, Li-Rong; Guo, Wen-Xiu; Hu, Yun-Jie; Kuang, Qi-Xuan; Liu, Meng-Dan; Peng, Wan; Dai, Yi-Fei; Wang, Dong; Gu, Yu-Cheng; Guo, Da-Le; Deng, Yun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然产物trichodimerol的抗炎机制，涉及NF-kB通路蛋白表达和TLR4-MD2分子对接，但核心是炎症信号通路而非TF-DNA互作建模，仅分子对接为边缘方法。
abstract: Excessive inflammation causes chronic diseases and tissue damage. Although there has been drug treatment, its side effects are relatively large. Searching for effective anti-inflammatory drugs from natural products has become the focus of attention. First isolated from Trichoderma longibraciatum, trichodimerol is a natural product with TNF inhibition. In this study, lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced RAW264.7 macrophages were used as a model to investigate the anti-inflammatory activity of trichodimerol. The results of nitric oxide (NO) detection, enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), and reactive oxygen species (ROS) showed that trichodimerol could reduce the production of NO, ROS, and the proinflammatory cytokines interleukin (IL)-6 and tumor necrosis factor (TNF)-alpha. Western blotting results showed that trichodimerol could inhibit the production of inflammatory mediators such as cyclooxygenase (COX)-2 and inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS) and the protein expression of nuclear transcription factor-kappaB (NF-kappaB), p-IKK, p-IkappaB, Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4), NOD-like receptor thermal protein domain associated protein 3 (NLRP3), cysteinyl aspartate specific proteinase (Caspase)-1, and ASC, which indicated that trichodimerol may inhibit inflammation through the NF-kappaB and NLRP3 pathways. At the same time, molecular docking showed that trichodimerol can directly combine with the TLR4-MD2 complex. Hence, trichodimerol inhibits inflammation by obstructing the interaction between LPS and the TLR4-MD2 heterodimer and suppressing the downstream NF-kappaB and NLRP3 pathways.
abstract_zh: 过度炎症会导致慢性疾病和组织损伤。尽管已有药物治疗，但其副作用相对较大。从天然产物中寻找有效的抗炎药物已成为关注焦点。trichodimerol首次从长枝木霉中分离得到，是一种具有TNF抑制活性的天然产物。本研究以脂多糖（LPS）诱导的RAW264.7巨噬细胞为模型，探讨trichodimerol的抗炎活性。一氧化氮（NO）检测、酶联免疫吸附试验（ELISA）和活性氧（ROS）结果表明，trichodimerol能减少NO、ROS及促炎细胞因子白细胞介素（IL）-6和肿瘤坏死因子（TNF）-α的产生。Western blotting结果显示，trichodimerol能抑制环氧化酶（COX）-2和诱导型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）等炎症介质的产生，以及核转录因子-κB（NF-κB）、p-IKK、p-IκB、Toll样受体4（TLR4）、NOD样受体热蛋白结构域相关蛋白3（NLRP3）、半胱氨酸天冬氨酸特异性蛋白酶（Caspase）-1和ASC的蛋白表达，这表明trichodimerol可能通过NF-κB和NLRP3通路抑制炎症。同时，分子对接显示trichodimerol能直接与TLR4-MD2复合物结合。因此，trichodimerol通过阻碍LPS与TLR4-MD2异二聚体的相互作用，并抑制下游NF-κB和NLRP3通路来发挥抗炎作用。
